name: io.github.zhenwei2972/mhs-printer
title: Bambu Lab 3D printers (MHS)
description: Operate Bambu Lab 3D printers over the LAN: print, schedule, monitor, camera, printability

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Printer IP address on your LAN, from the printer screen under Settings > Network.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_SERIAL
environmentVariables.description: Printer serial number. Used as the TLS certificate name, so it must match exactly.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_ACCESS_CODE
environmentVariables.description: LAN access code shown on the printer screen. Never leaves your network.

environmentVariables.name: BAMBU_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Printer model, used for build volume and safety limits: 'A1 mini', 'A1', 'P1P', 'P1S' or 'X1C'.

environmentVariables.name: MHS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for monitoring and camera only; every write is refused. Recommended for a first run.

environmentVariables.name: MHS_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the scheduled-job queue, print journal and captured frames are stored.

environmentVariables.name: MHS_MOCK
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run against a simulated printer, so every tool can be tried without hardware.
